notablePrerequisites: You control at least seven Swamps.
description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Endless Cockroaches, adding {C}{C}.
Endless Cockroaches dies, returning itself from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Cabal Coffers by paying {2} and tapping it, adding at least seven {B}.
Cast Endless Cockroaches by paying {1}{B}{B}.
Onyx Talisman triggers, causing you to pay {3} to untap Cabal Coffers.
Repeat.
